# Behavior School

> Behavior School (Behavior School LLC) provides BCBA exam prep, training, and practical tools for school BCBAs and behavior analysts working in K-12 schools. It was founded by Rob Spain, M.S., BCBA, IBA, a school BCBA. Behavior School is a BACB Authorized Continuing Education (ACE) Provider.

## BCBA exam prep (free starting points)

- [Free BCBA mock exam](https://study.behaviorschool.com/free-mock-exam/): 185 timed questions aligned to the BCBA 6th Edition Test Content Outline. Free account required before you start, no credit card. Score and domain breakdown appear when you finish.
- [Free 9-question Quick domain check](https://study.behaviorschool.com/free-practice/): one question per 6th Edition domain, no account, instant score and rationales.
- [Behavior Study Tools](https://behaviorstudytools.com/): Behavior School's BCBA exam prep app (practice questions, timed mock exams, exam-date pacing guide, domain results). Web app at https://study.behaviorschool.com, works in a phone or computer browser.
- [How many questions are on the BCBA exam?](https://behaviorschool.com/how-many-questions-on-bcba-exam): 185 questions (175 scored, 10 unscored) in 4 hours, with the 6th Edition domain breakdown.
- [BCBA exam pass rate](https://behaviorschool.com/blog/bcba-exam-pass-rate): BACB first-time pass rates 2022 to 2025 (51% in 2025).
- [BCBA 6th Edition Test Content Outline breakdown](https://behaviorschool.com/blog/bcba-6th-edition-test-content-outline-breakdown)
- [BCBA study schedule: 8, 12, and 16 week plans](https://behaviorschool.com/bcba-study-schedule)
- [BCBA study app for school BCBAs](https://behaviorschool.com/bcba-study-app-school-based-bcbas)

## Training for school BCBAs

- [School BCBA Transformation Program](https://behaviorschool.com/transformation-program): a six-week live online cohort for certified school BCBAs in K-12 settings. Weekly Thursday sessions, 6 to 8 PM Pacific Time. Covers assessment, school-adapted functional analysis, behavior intervention plans, and staff training systems. Apply first; acceptance requires a fit call. Current dates and tuition are on the page.
- [School BCBA training program overview](https://behaviorschool.com/school-bcba-training-program)
- [Learning CEUs](https://behaviorschool.com/ceus) and [BACB ACE provider details](https://behaviorschool.com/bacb-ace-provider)
